title: Reverse with the stack
description:
Read numbers and print them in reverse order using `push` and `pop`.

```
Numbers (0 to stop): 1 2 3 4 0
4 3 2 1
```

starter.main.asm:
global  _start

        section .data
ask:    db      "Numbers (0 to stop): ", 0

        section .text
_start:
        lea     rdi, [rel ask]
        call    print_str
        xor     ebx, ebx
.read:
        call    read_int
        ; TODO: stop at 0, otherwise push and count

        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

hints: Every `push` must be matched by a `pop`, or `rsp` ends in the wrong place (lesson 4.04).
Calls push a return address, but each routine pops it again, so your values stay underneath.
requirements: `push` each number as it is read; count them in `rbx`.
`pop` them all and print; the stack must be back where it started at the end.
stretch: Check brackets in a line (`(a[b]{c})`) with the stack.
